name: B10-0128/2026 (S&D) – Systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Iran's violent crackdown on peaceful protests, which human rights groups say has killed at least 7,000 people. It asks the European Union to use all diplomatic means to end the impunity of Iranian officials, to help restore full internet access in Iran, and to fully apply recent sanctions. It demands that Iran release everyone jailed for peaceful protest, and calls for EU work to free detained European citizens. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The EU is urged to apply its newest sanctions fully and stop them being dodged.
- Iranians facing repression and detained EU citizens are the focus.
- Parliament asks the EU's diplomatic service and member states to act on releases.
